summary: Frontend-only verification of Get-the-app feature. Header shows a persistent blue 'Get the app' button. Clicking it opens the shadcn Dialog titled 'Get the Blackrod Now app' with both Install and Notifications sections. In headless Chromium (no beforeinstallprompt), the Install section correctly falls back to browser-menu instructions. Notifications section renders the 'Turn on notifications' button (data-testid='get-app-notify-on'). Dialog closes with Escape. No console errors detected.

test_results.install_section: PASS — section rendered; showed browser-menu install instructions (no beforeinstallprompt in headless Chromium — expected)
test_results.notifications_section: PASS — get-app-notify-on button present (not clicked, per instructions)

critical_code_review_comments: GetAppButton: trigger label doesn't change to 'Notifications' when standalone due to placement on desktop hidden sm:inline-flex — cosmetic only.
PostInstallNotifyBanner not shown in normal browser tab (guarded by isStandalone()) — matches spec; cannot verify visually without PWA installation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature verified in desktop Chromium. Install button (get-app-install) will only appear in browsers that fire beforeinstallprompt (Android/Chrome); headless Chromium in preview shows the fallback instructions branch — this is expected. Notification and install buttons were intentionally NOT clicked to avoid real permission prompts.
